business_problem: Virgin Media Ireland needed to modernize legacy infrastructure supporting its telecommunications business so it could move faster, improve operational visibility, and create a cloud foundation for future analytics and AI services.
solution_summary: Virgin Media Ireland used Google Cloud as the foundation for its wider telecommunications transformation while moving from legacy platforms toward a more automated, Kubernetes-based operating model. Working with Google Cloud and partner Prodapt, the company redesigned existing applications to run across cloud and on-premises environments, with Google Kubernetes Engine and Compute Engine becoming the main compute platforms for critical workloads such as wholesale billing and service operations. The organization also consolidated its API gateway on Apigee so access endpoints could be governed from one place with better visibility and control. That modernization work improved deployment speed, enabled richer operational assurance monitoring across broadband and television services, and created a unified cloud platform that can support future Gemini-based and agentic AI workloads. The result is a telco estate that is more automated, more observable, and easier to extend.

solution_components.role: Runs modernized telecommunications workloads with full automation and faster deployment cycles.

solution_components.role: Hosts critical cloud workloads alongside the company's Kubernetes-based environments.

solution_components.name: Apigee

solution_components.name: Gemini
solution_components.role: Provides the model ecosystem Virgin Media Ireland is using for new scalable AI workloads.
